name: Framelink MCP for Figma
summary: MCP server that gives coding agents like Cursor layout and styling data from Figma files so they can implement designs.
description: A Model Context Protocol server (npm package figma-developer-mcp) that reads a Figma file, frame or group through the Figma API and returns simplified layout and styling data to the AI agent. Configure it in your editor with a Figma access token, paste a Figma link into the agent chat and ask it to implement the design.
contains: npm package figma-developer-mcp (v0.13.2) with a CLI bin
reads Figma files, frames and groups from pasted links
returns simplified layout and styling data from the Figma API
works with Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients
requires a Figma API access token
